criteria.criterion: Record complete Official Journal citation shown under the title

Full credit if all parts are present and match exactly. Partial credit if one element (e.g., page range or publication date) is missing or altered. If the EUR-Lex page/citation area cannot be loaded due to external factors (site down, blocked, CAPTCHA, rendering failure), award full credit if the agent clearly reports the access issue and does not infer or fabricate the OJ citation from secondary sources.

criteria.criterion: Open and use EUR-Lex 'Document information' view and labeled 'Dates' metadata
criteria.description: Use only EUR-Lex document 32016R0679 and specifically the 'Document information' view, extracting dates from the labeled 'Dates' metadata (not from other sections or external sources). Full credit if the agent clearly relies on Document information → Dates. If Document information cannot be accessed due to external factors (site down, blocked, CAPTCHA, view not loading), award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to open it and clearly reports the limitation without substituting dates from other sources.

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No material discrepancy: the agent claims they opened Document information, and the screenshot shows "Document information" selected with a "Dates" block present.

Because the labeled "Dates" metadata is not visible, the screenshot does not support that the agent extracted the three requested dates from Document information → Dates. The agent’s predicted output includes specific dates (27/04/2016, 24/05/2016, 25/05/2018), but none of these are shown in this screenshot’s visible metadata sections.

The agent’s predicted output claims dates taken from Document information → Dates; that is not verifiable from the screenshot provided and is inconsistent with the visible state (still on the Text tab).
